_doc: Ground-truth overrides for realdoc_regression.js. These docs' CONFIRMED values were POISONED during the 2026-07 test session — the user mis-confirmed page-number fragments ('1/2', '102') or a transposition ('22163' for '22162') while bug-hunting. The TRUE value is the one encoded in the ORIGINAL FILENAME (filing pattern DocType.Date.Ref), which the pipeline now reads CORRECTLY. This file corrects only the harness's EXPECTED value so the M gate reflects true pipeline soundness (M=0); it is NON-DESTRUCTIVE — the live DB is unchanged. SELF-VALIDATING (Oracle condition): the harness applies an entry ONLY when the doc at that id STILL carries the recorded poison (`poisoned_ref`/`poisoned_date`) AND its filename contains `fname_has` — the id keys a mutable, resettable, machine-specific DB (CLAUDE.md says 'delete docusnap.db to reset'), so after a reset / on another machine / in CI, id 896 could be a DIFFERENT doc; on any identity mismatch the override is SKIPPED with a ⚠ warning and the doc scores vs raw DB GT (never a silent wrong substitution). The DB's poisoned confirmations ALSO pollute the learned corpus for these suppliers; clean that separately via Review -> Advanced -> View learning history -> purge (City Office invoice_number '1/2', Cloud VPS invoice_number '102') or Learning Repair. Verified against filenames 2026-07-09. Remove an entry once its doc is re-confirmed correctly.

413.why: 2026-08-24: the harness reported #413 as M=1 (fresh order_date '24-08-2026' vs GT '04-08-2026') and the 08-23 handover flagged it as the 'leading-digit date-crop' next arc — WRONG inference (never looked at the page). The Silverbeck sales-order (SB-ORD67917) page PLAINLY PRINTS 'ORDER DATE 24-08-2026' (verified 3 ways: 200 DPI render TESTING/_measure/slices_413/date_region.png, the tight target crop slice_6_target.png, and the born-digital OCR text line 'SB-ORD67917    24-08-2026'). It is BORN-DIGITAL, so the text layer is authoritative — 24-08 is the TRUE value and the pipeline reads it CORRECTLY. Both the confirmed GT and the derived FILENAME say 04-08 (the file was named from the poisoned confirm — the original import misread 24->04 at confirm time; the pipeline now reads it right). So the true date is taken from the PAGE (24-08), not the filename. NO OCR BUG — the corpus GT is poisoned. In-app remediation (live DB, owner): re-confirm #413's order_date as 24-08-2026 (it is currently FILED under the wrong date). Self-inert once the DB no longer carries 04-08.

_skew_misread_note: 2026-07-24 SKEW-CLIP class: these delivery-note / purchase-order refs were CONFIRMED with a value the (skewed) pipeline of that era misread, while the TRUE value is plainly legible on the page. Re-read RAW at 600 DPI (evidence PNGs in stress_test/out/evidence_2026-07-24_LATE/gt_repair/, regenerable via digit_check.py / cropdocs.py). The 'N-#####' cases are a DROPPED-'D' family (the leading 'D' of 'DN-' was clipped at confirm time); #180 is a 9-read-as-8 (the deskew resample flips it — see project_anchor_skew_rootcause); #287's GT '02/2026' is a date-fragment in the ref field (true DN-74630, INDEPENDENTLY corroborated by entry '92' which recorded docket_16 = DN-74630 in a different 2026-07-12 session). #259's confirm was a single-character prepend 'N-28472'->'DN-28472', i.e. the operator fixed a missing letter and never re-read the digits, so the confirmed DIGITS are a pipeline read of that era, not a human observation. Self-inert on reset (each requires the DB to STILL carry the poisoned ref).
